name: forecasting_run_sales_forecast_job
description:
Trigger the sales-forecast Glue ETL job that re-computes forecasts and writes the results to the Iceberg table.

The job is idempotent: it deletes existing rows for the target calc_period + scenario_uuid + company_id before appending fresh results.

The tool returns immediately with a JobRunId. Use forecasting_check_sales_forecast_job_status to monitor progress.

Jobs typically take 3-5 minutes to complete.

SCENARIO SELECTION (precedence):
1. scenario_uuids if provided (explicit override).
2. scenario_id if provided — resolved to its scenario_uuid server-side.
3. Otherwise the company's default_scenario_id (from forecasting settings) is used and resolved server-side.
In most cases pass only company_id + calc_period and let the company default apply. Use forecasting_get_company_settings to inspect the default_scenario_id.

IMPORTANT:
- company_id and calc_period are REQUIRED.
- After starting, use forecasting_check_sales_forecast_job_status — do NOT check earlier than 3 minutes.

company_id.description: Required. The company to run the forecast for. Use forecasting_get_company_settings to look up the company's forecasting configuration.

calc_period.description: Required. Calculation period in YYYY-MM format (e.g. '2026-03').

scenario_uuids.description: Optional explicit override. Scenario UUID(s) to run. If omitted, the tool resolves the scenario from scenario_id or the company's default_scenario_id server-side.

scenario_id.description: Optional. Numeric sales_forecast_scenario_id; resolved to its scenario_uuid server-side. Ignored if scenario_uuids is provided. If both scenario_uuids and scenario_id are omitted, the company's default_scenario_id is used.

inventory_id.description: Optional. Run forecast for a single inventory item only. Omit to run for ALL items in the company.

job_run_id.description: The Glue JobRunId for tracking via forecasting_check_sales_forecast_job_status.

state.description: STARTED on success, DENIED if not authorized or scenario could not be resolved.

scenario_uuids.description: The scenario UUID(s) actually sent to the job after resolution.

resolved_scenario_id.description: The numeric scenario_id resolved (present when scenario came from scenario_id or the company default).

arguments_sent.description: The full argument map sent to the Glue job.

next_step.description: Guidance on what to do next.
